findings.title: Plugin request completion logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: This change removes the explicit `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` extraction that previously appended `traceID` to every plugin request completion log. The new contextual middleware only adds endpoint/plugin/user/data-source attributes; it does not add a trace ID. Consequently, requests that have an active trace can no longer be correlated from the `Plugin Request Completed` log event to their trace, regressing existing observability behavior. Preserve the explicit trace field or ensure the contextual logger path adds the same `traceID` attribute.

findings.title: TestLogger drops log calls made through FromContext
findings.body: `FromContext` returns a newly allocated `TestLogger`, so a call such as `logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)` records on an unreachable logger rather than on the fake supplied by the test. `LoggerMiddleware` now logs exclusively through this path, making assertions on the original `TestLogger` silently miss request-completion logs. Make the fake retain/shared-recording state (or return itself for `FromContext`) and add coverage that verifies contextual logger middleware attributes reach the logger middleware.
